title: Black Forest Games leaves THQ Nordic in a management buyout and co-founds Third Signal

sources.note: company press release 11 Nov 2026: management buyout, founding member of Third Signal (co-owned by Third Signal Ventures and studio management), THQ Nordic keeps collaborating on development tasks, studio keeps developing and publishing under own label; no financial terms; headcount not in release

first_report: 2026-11-11 (company release on Games Press); not yet carried in Arabic outlets

angle.hook: the studio behind the Destroy All Humans! remakes buys itself out of THQ Nordic
angle.why_now: company release of 11 Nov, under 24 hours, no Arabic coverage found
angle.what_it_means_here: Destroy All Humans! and Giana Sisters players: the studio goes independent but keeps working with THQ Nordic; no price or deal terms disclosed
angle.payoff: Third Signal is a new independent studio group for premium PC and console games
